title: Organisations
name: Name
changeConfirm: Are you sure you want to switch the active organisation?
leaveConfirm: Are you sure you want to leave this organisation? This action cannot be undone.
deleteConfirm: Are you sure you want to delete this organisation? This action cannot be undone.
removeMemberConfirm: Are you sure you want to remove {email} from this organisation?
userNotFoundInfo: This user doesn't have an account yet. You can invite them to join the app and your organisation.

metadata.title: Document tags
metadata.description: Define the key-value tags every document in this organisation can use. Each key can allow free text or a fixed list of values.
metadata.label: Label
metadata.descriptionPlaceholder: e.g. Name of the device manufacturer
metadata.descriptionHint: Instruction for the PDF parser describing exactly what to extract. Leave empty to use the label.
metadata.valuesHint: Comma-separated. Leave empty to allow free text.
metadata.duplicateKey: Each tag key must be unique.

pageTypes.title: Page types
pageTypes.description: Manage this organisation's page types and give each one an icon and a colour. Both appear in the wiki tree and above the page title. A type that pages still use can be restyled but not renamed or removed — existing pages would otherwise no longer save.
pageTypes.empty: No page types are configured for this organisation.
pageTypes.notPersisted: The icons could not be saved: this server does not support page type presentation yet. Saving works without any further change once the framework update is deployed.
pageTypes.inUseLocked: Used by {count} page(s) — renaming and removal locked.
pageTypes.emptyKey: Every page type needs a key.
pageTypes.label: Label

branding.title: Colors
branding.description: Customize the primary highlight color and the secondary color for this organisation. Changes apply to everyone in the organisation.
branding.primaryHint: Used for highlighted buttons and accents.

embedding.title: AI search (embeddings)
embedding.description: Additionally index every page of this organisation semantically, so meaning-based search and AI answers can find them. The setting is organisation-wide — deliberately not per page.
embedding.enable: Semantically index all pages of this organisation
embedding.enableHint: New and edited pages are indexed automatically from now on. Existing pages are marked and get their vectors the next time they are saved.
embedding.providerMissing: The server has no API key for the embedding provider “{provider}”. While {envVar} is missing no page gets indexed — the setting can be saved, but it only takes effect once the key is set.
embedding.disabled: AI search disabled ({count} index entrie(s) removed)
embedding.pending: {count} page(s) are marked for AI search but have no vectors yet — they were created before the setting was enabled.
embedding.backfill: Index them now in the background
embedding.backfillHint: The pages are indexed one after another through the job queue. Depending on the number this takes a few minutes, and it can be triggered again at any time — pages that are already queued are skipped.

logo.title: Logo
logo.hint: Shown at the top of the sidebar in place of the organisation name.
logo.uploadHint: JPG, PNG or GIF, max. 5 MB. Cropped on upload.
logo.deleteConfirm: Are you sure you want to remove this organisation's logo?

errors.tooLarge: The image is too large (max. 5 MB)

errors.embeddingSaveFailed: AI search setting could not be saved
